scope: Pure-arithmetic reward math: _updatePool stable accrual (cap/strand/re-anchor), _claimRewards & view reward-debt subtraction (underflow), phUSDPerSecond emission floor/overflow, dust-regime accStablePerShare bounds, two-step APY gate.
notes: FAIL = Halmos found a reachable counterexample. Several FAILs are EXPECTED-and-confirmatory (they prove a known LOCAL/ECON defect exists, e.g. strand>0, re-anchor under-distribution, dust emission zeroing) rather than being new bugs. Only the _claimRewards / pending* reward-debt underflow (M-01 / CODE-002) is a genuine reachable-panic finding; it is already ledgered. Three PROVE-properties of _updatePool TIMED OUT in Halmos at both 1e30 and 2^64 scale (nested symbolic integer divisions are intractable for the bitvector solver regardless of value bounds); they were discharged by forge fuzz (50k runs, all PASS) plus a closed-form Euclidean argument and are recorded as proved-by-fallback.

findings.property: user.amount * accPerShare / PRECISION >= reward-debt (subtraction must not underflow) after a pauseWithdraw->unpause->claim trajectory
findings.severity: verified-high (confirms ledger M-01 / CODE-002, severity Medium per C4)

witness_family_decoded.withdrawnBps: 8192 (81.92% pulled via pauseWithdraw, debt left anchored to amount0)

This STRENGTHENS M-01: the underflow does not require any further accrual between pauseWithdraw and claim.

findings.remediationProof: check_claim_clamped_remediation_is_safe PASSED: clamping the subtraction (pending = lhs > debt ? lhs - debt : 0), or rebasing the debt inside pauseWithdraw, removes the panic for all inputs.
findings.proof: Halmos symbolic execution found a reachable assertion violation; mirrors ledger M-01 PoC (poc-M-01-claim-underflow.t.sol).
findings.reconciliation: Maps to ledger M-01 (stale phUSDDebt after pauseWithdraw -> _claimRewards underflow). Not net-new; symbolic proof reinforces it and broadens it to the static-accumulator case and to the pending* views (CODE-007).

findings.verdict: DISPROVED — reachable underflow (views revert instead of returning 0)
findings.severity: verified-low/qa (view DoS; same root cause as M-01)

findings.reconciliation: Same stale-debt root cause as M-01 (CODE-007). pendingPhUSD/pendingStable should clamp at 0; current code reverts, breaking off-chain integrations that read these views for a post-pauseWithdraw user.

confirmatoryCounterexamples.verdict: Disproved 'no strand' -> a non-zero rounding strand DOES occur in a single _updatePool step

counterexample.meaning: rewardBalance -= toDistribute (full) while accStablePerShare += floor(toDistribute*PRECISION/totalStaked); the floored remainder leaves rewardBalance uncredited to any share.

confirmatoryCounterexamples.boundedComplement: check_singleStep_strand_bounded proves the strand per update is < totalStaked/PRECISION + 1 wei (TIMEOUT in Halmos, PROVED by fuzz + Euclidean closed form). So each poke strands at most ~totalStaked/1e18 reward-wei; accumulates under LOCAL-001's frequent re-pokes.

confirmatoryCounterexamples.result: FAIL (expected) / fuzz PASS on strict shortfall
confirmatoryCounterexamples.verdict: Disproved 'two pokes == one poke' -> splitting a depletion window distributes STRICTLY LESS; ~25% shortfall at N=2 pokes
confirmatoryCounterexamples.maps: LOCAL-001 / ECON-001 (exponential decay vs intended linear depletion; re-anchor at L416)

counterexample.fuzzWitness: B0=1,000,000e18, D=1 week: one poke distributes ~B0; two equal pokes distribute ~0.75*B0 (assertApproxEqRel to 75% within 1% PASSED), matching ECON-001's N=2 -> 75% figure.

confirmatoryCounterexamples.verdict: Disproved 'funded stake with positive APY always emits' -> phUSDPerSecond floors to 0
confirmatoryCounterexamples.maps: Profile section 3 emission-rounding note; amplified by LOCAL-005 dust (pauseWithdraw below MINIMUM_STAKE)

counterexample.meaning: totalStaked*desiredAPYBps < 10000*SECONDS_PER_YEAR (~3.1536e11) -> phUSDPerSecond = 0; no phUSD ever emitted while in this state.

confirmatoryCounterexamples.guardProof: check_emissionRate_nonzero_above_minimum PROVED: with totalStaked >= MINIMUM_STAKE (1e15) and bps >= 1, the rate is always > 0. The zeroing only manifests once the INV-6 dust invariant is broken (i.e. via pauseWithdraw, LOCAL-005).

confirmatoryCounterexamples.verdict: A theoretical overflow of user.amount * accStablePerShare exists only at jointly-implausible magnitudes; OUT OF REALISTIC RANGE

counterexample.meaning: product ~4e87 > 2^256 (~1.16e77). Requires absurd token supply AND an absurd dust-inflated accumulator simultaneously; would brick stake/claim (checked-math revert), not steal funds. check_dust_claim_product_safe_realistic PROVED safe at realistic bounds (amount<1e27, acc<1e30).

proofs.property: INV-3/INV-4 cap: a single _updatePool removes at most rewardBalance (toDistribute = min(potential, rewardBalance) <= rewardBalance). No stable over-distribution per call.

proofs.halmosStatus: TIMEOUT at 1e30 and 2^64 (nested symbolic division intractable)
proofs.property: INV-4: per-share rounding never credits MORE than toDistribute (creditedBack = accInc*totalStaked/PRECISION <= toDistribute). Rounding can only strand, never inflate.
LOCAL-004 magnitude: strand per update < totalStaked/PRECISION + 1 wei (strand*PRECISION < totalStaked + PRECISION).

proofs.tool: forge-fuzz (50000 runs, symbolic B0 and D)
proofs.property: Re-anchor monotonicity: splitting the depletion window never distributes MORE than a single poke (delivery is monotonically non-increasing in poke count).
With totalStaked >= MINIMUM_STAKE (1e15) and desiredAPYBps >= 1, phUSDPerSecond > 0 (emission cannot floor to zero while INV-6 holds).
Even at totalStaked == 1 wei (max dust), accStablePerShare += (toDistribute*PRECISION)/totalStaked does not overflow for realistic per-update reward (< 1e30); increment <= toDistribute*PRECISION.
user.amount * accStablePerShare does not overflow for realistic magnitudes (amount < 1e27, accStablePerShare < 1e30).

phUSDPerSecond = totalStaked*desiredAPYBps/10000/SECONDS_PER_YEAR and its forward projection timeElapsed*phUSDPerSecond*PRECISION do not overflow for totalStaked<1e30, bps<1e30, elapsed<1000y. (Supersedes the weaker check_emission_rate_no_overflow which TIMED OUT on a tautological assert; the emission-rate product is a strict sub-term of this proved bound, so emission-rate overflow is covered.)
(toDistribute*PRECISION)/totalStaked does not overflow for totalStaked in [1, 1e30), toDistribute < 1e30.
Clamped subtraction (pending = lhs > debt ? lhs - debt : 0) is panic-free for all inputs -> validates the M-01 remediation.
From a fresh state (apySetInProgress == false) any setDesiredAPY call goes to PREVIEW (cannot commit in one tx).
block.number > pendingAPYBlockNumber + 100 always forces PREVIEW (stale pending cannot silently commit).
INV-9: commit reachable IFF apySetInProgress AND block.number <= pending+100 AND bps == pendingAPYBps.
+100 boundary is inclusive: block == pending+100 allows commit.
block == pending+101 falls back to PREVIEW.

Discharged by UpdatePoolFuzz.testFuzz_singleStep_strand_bounded (50k runs PASS) + Euclidean proof (strand*PRECISION = r1 + r2 < totalStaked + PRECISION).

timeouts.resolution: Discharged by UpdatePoolFuzz.testFuzz_reanchor_two_pokes_le_one (50k runs, symbolic B0 and D, PASS).

timeouts.reason: Tautological assert (phUSDPerSecond <= product) over huge symbolic ranges with division; solver cannot close it quickly.
timeouts.resolution: Superseded by check_phUSDReward_projection_no_overflow (PASS), which proves no overflow for the larger projected product that strictly dominates the emission-rate product. Overflow concern considered RESOLVED.
